text:
The reaper, with pauses of music,

was reaping the afternoon.

His sickle is so fine

that it reaps the sweet ears and reaps the afternoon.


Reaper who walks on golden levels

with his sharpened sound,

defeating the fine heights of gold,

he also brings down the sunset.


He reaped the clear ears.

His pause was music.

His shadow lengthened the afternoon.

In his eyes he brought a morning star

that sometimes leaped over the whole landscape.


The sickle, sharpened so finely,

reaped the same:

the ear of grain and the last sun of afternoon.

translation.title: The Reaper, with Pauses of Music...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the reaper's sickle cutting both grain and sunset.
